title: Mortgage Loan File Borrower Fee Terms: Application Fee Refunds and Credit at Closing
content:
**Terms.**

(a) Only the application fee on a Mortgage Loan File is ever refunded or applied at closing; credit report fees are final once the report is pulled.

(b) **Denial.** When Larkspur denies a file and the program refunds the application fee on denial, the application fee is refunded in full, with the entry reason recorded as a denial refund.

(c) **Withdrawal.** A withdrawal refund of the application fee is issued only when the borrower's withdrawal was recorded within the refund window that started on the application fee's entry date. Such a refund is recorded with the entry reason of a withdrawal refund and is booked as a withdrawal refund. Business days are counted forward from the application fee entry date, which is day zero; the withdrawal date (the file's closed date) must fall on or before the last business day of the window. The window is the program's withdrawal refund window in business days. A business day is Monday through Friday excluding the US federal public holidays observed by the Federal Reserve Banks; Saturdays, Sundays and those holidays are skipped when counting. A withdrawal after the window keeps the fee.

(d) **Improper collection.** An application fee collected before intent to proceed is refunded in full whenever found, with the entry reason of an improper collection refund, whatever the file's status.

(e) **Consummation.** At consummation, where the program credits the application fee at closing, the collected application fee is credited on the Closing Disclosure as a Closing Disclosure credit line, with the entry reason applied at closing; where the program does not, the fee stays paid.

(f) **Form of every refund or application.** Every refund or closing application names the original fee entry it reverses and carries that entry's full amount, and refunds go back to the same payment method; a fee entry is refunded or applied at most once.

The evidence for the withdrawal window is the system's fee record of the application fee (its entry date) and the file's closed date, matched to the fee entry being refunded.

## Withdrawal window, worked through (hypothetical dates, 3-business-day window, no holidays in the period)

| Application fee entry date | Withdrawal recorded (closed date) | Business day count | Refund |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wednesday | following Monday | Thursday 1, Friday 2, Monday 3 — the last business day of the window | full withdrawal refund |
| Wednesday | following Tuesday | day 4 | none; the fee is kept |
| Friday | following Wednesday | Monday 1, Tuesday 2, Wednesday 3 | full withdrawal refund |

## Outcome table by event

| Event | Application fee | Credit report fee |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur denies the file (program refunds on denial) | refunded in full | final |
| Borrower withdraws on or before the last business day of the window | refunded in full | final |
| Borrower withdraws after the window | kept | final |
| Fee found to have been collected before intent to proceed | refunded in full, whatever the status | final |
| Consummation, program credits the fee at closing | credited on the Closing Disclosure | final |
| Consummation, program does not credit the fee | stays paid | final |
